background.text: The structure of demand in the second Florentine period differs in kind from the first. To the religious houses and private patrons is added the republic itself, and the commissions span altarpiece (the Saint Anne for the Servites), state imagery (the Battle of Anghiari), military hydraulics (the Arno diversion), and private portraiture. Novellara's observation that mathematical experiments had drawn Leonardo away from painting is among the rare contemporary testimonies to his order of priorities in these years. The Arno diversion, an attempt to strangle Pisa by moving the river, failed at the excavation stage in 1504. It is nonetheless one of the few dossiers in which the Signoria, Leonardo, and the chancellor Machiavelli appear within a single documentary chain, and together with the Borgia service of the following section it defines the ground on which any contact between the two men can be examined at the level of documents.
